items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: Two movements compress a symphony into canons and a closing set of seven variations. Boulez’s Berlin recording is a choice for clear orchestral detail, a quality singled out by BBC Music Magazine.

links.title: Deutsche Grammophon — Boulez and the Berliner Philharmoniker, complete Symphony on Boulez Conducts Webern III

items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: Three piano movements unfold from a single twelve-note row; Webern wrote the finale first. Zimerman’s warmth led Greg Sandow to compare the result with Chopin, singling it out among the set’s best performances.
